title: staggered-canary-checkin-panel-ui-handover-2027-07-19
notes:
Purpose: quick standup focused on staggered canary for Panel UI patch (panel-ux-v2), analytics tagging, and handover tasks for oncall/data team.

Attendees: Priya, Liam, Ana, Raj, Morgan (10m).

Summary:
- We kicked off a staggered canary targeted at 2% -> 10% -> 50% traffic windows. First window (2%) rolled out 07:00 PDT with early probes.
- Early telemetry shows small uptick in client-side render errors on Safari (0.12% -> 0.35%) during the 2% window; front-end metric spike correlated with a new intersection-observer polyfill.
- Backend route latency to /panel/load increased by ~8ms p50 under the canary cohort. Hypothesis: new panel-state hydration adds an additional fetch for saved-state; need to evaluate batching.
- Analytics tagging: Ana validated event schema for panel_open, panel_prefetch_hit, and panel_experiment_bucket. There was one missing attribute (experiment_variant) in the prefetch_hit event; patch queued.
- Rollout gating: agreed to hold at 10% if Safari error rate > 0.5% or panel_prefetch_hit rate drops by > 15%. Current metrics: Safari errs 0.35% (ok), prefetch_hit steady at -3%.

Observed oddities / informal notes:
- A/B harness sometimes double-counts impressions when user opens panel from deep-link; probably debounce bug in the client. Ticket noted.
- Local repro for the fetch extra call only appears when saved-state size > ~12kb. This explains why not everyone sees latency diff.
- Quick manual check: rollback script tested in staging and works; rollback time ~2m.

Decisions:
- Proceed to 10% on Monday 07:30 PDT if no regression overnight and after deploy-safety wait (2h) passes.
- Ana to push schema patch for prefetch_hit before 10% window.
- Raj to open small follow-up to debounce impressions in A/B harness (low risk patch).
- Morgan to add a short-run synthetic test that creates saved-state ~16kb and runs panel load 1000x to measure p50/p95.
decisions: Move to 10% across cohort on 2027-07-19 07:30 PDT if no regressions
Require analytics schema patch deployed before expanding to 10%
Delay 50% expansion until synthetic test completes and no regressions observed
action_items: Ana: deploy analytics prefetch_hit schema patch (CON-1942) - due 2027-07-19 12:00 PDT
Raj: open debounce-impressions PR and link to canary (github PR referenced) - due 2027-07-20
Morgan: run saved-state synthetic load test and upload results to Confluence - due 2027-07-20 EOD
Priya: monitor canary dashboard and pulse Slack #panel-rollouts during 07:00-10:00 PDT windows
blockers: Safari render error still elevated but below hold threshold. Main blocker for faster expansion is missing analytics attribute (experiment_variant) in one event stream until Ana's patch goes live. Also want synthetic test results before 50% expansion.
retro-notes: Two small process items: (1) next time we plan staggered canary, include synthetic saved-state tests in preflight checklist; (2) add a short smoke to validate experiment_variant on the edge analytics proxy to catch missing attributes earlier.
